findings.title: Spoken remembrance makes the missed route recoverable
findings.claim: At the focus's mention of the fish, speech turns a private lapse into a route that can be recovered jointly.
findings.mechanism: The focus occurrence 18:63:15:1 carries root_000516/B004, the act of putting the fish into speech; the direct forgetting-and-remembrance parallel at 18:24 supplies an independent trigger, so the report itself becomes the contact through which the lost event returns to shared knowledge.
findings.reader_payoff: The fish's escape is newly legible as a recoverable waypoint in the conversation: remembering is effective here because it is voiced and shared.
findings.containment: The ordinary confession that the fish was forgotten remains intact. This does not claim that the fish intended to signal a destination, or that the spoken reading replaces the narrative attribution of forgetfulness.

epistemic.reason: A trusted publication supplies the anchored branch claim; the reader-walk support supplies the shared-speech mechanism, while its legacy-unbound status and the supplied counter-limit require qualification.

branch_activations.boundary: The activation concerns the report's recoverability; it does not assign intention to the fish or erase the plain confession of forgetting.

findings.title: The rock fixes a moving event in place

findings.mechanism: The focus occurrence 18:63:6:2 carries root_000847/B001, the large hard rock; the supplied wide walk connects that fixed point with the reversal in 18:64 and the sought encounter in 18:65, so the rock's stability contacts the later return movement.
findings.reader_payoff: The definite rock becomes a navigational index within the sea scene: the event can be retraced because one fixed object holds its location.
findings.containment: The plain shelter at the rock remains the scene. This does not claim that the rock caused the fish's movement or that the destination was intentionally signaled by the fish.

epistemic.reason: The trusted publication anchors the rock branch, while the wide reader-walk and retrospective support supply the reverse-route consequence under legacy-unbound qualification.

findings.mechanism: The focus occurrence 18:63:13:2 names Satan in the exclusive cause construction; supplied connection rows at 6:68, 12:42, 58:19, and 25:29 independently pair Satan with causing forgetting or losing remembrance, so the one-time attribution contacts a wider obstruction pattern.
findings.reader_payoff: The lapse becomes a blocked communicative return: the reader sees why the report's recovery requires a later act of remembrance and speech.
findings.containment: The ordinary narrative attribution remains in place. The connection targets lack supplied target morphology, and this finding makes no general theological claim and assigns no intention to the fish.

epistemic.reason: The cited connection rows provide direct or close authored parallels with strong and medium retrieval labels, but they do not supply an independent source-trust label or target morphology; those labels are treated as evidence, not as a verdict.
